title: Irving K NDE 6913
content: I was put by my parents in a ‘crib’ for young children where the water was up to chin level. They and maybe others were at the other end of the ‘crib’. I lost my footing because of a slimy bottom. Unable to regain my footing, I haplessly foundered under the water. I do not remember any fear or pain on trying to regain my upright position. Suddenly there appeared an unearthly bright light upon which I fixated. It was so very bright but did not hurt my ‘eyes’. It appeared to be fractionated into ‘squares’ or ‘rectangles’ or approximations and the colors varied between golden and yellows. They were absolutely beautiful. It seemed that my ‘eyes’ were forward focused but my entire ‘visual field’ took all this in. There was total peace and serenity, and perhaps in retrospect: love. I did not want the spectacle to end, and it appeared to go on and on. To the end, the ‘visual field’ did not materially change. Throughout the experience, I had no awareness of my physical body. Suddenly after seemingly an eternity, there was a sudden jolt and I felt and saw mass confusion around me as reality reappeared. I was lying on my back and faces hovered above me. I have no memory beyond this. My amnesia lasted apparently a long time. I do not remember my parents even talking to me about any experience I might have had. It seems life just returned to normal. I might mention that my father in his memoirs mentions that I almost drowned, that they found me on the floor of the ‘crib’. I have no idea of how long it took them to notice that I had disappeared from sight.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Near-drowning in a children's 'crib' with water up to chin level; slipped on a slimy bottom and went under water.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Uninterrupted fixation on an unearthly bright, fractionated light (squares/rectangles) with golden/yellow colors; then a sudden jolt with "mass confusion" and faces hovering above upon return.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: No OBE or tunnel described; experience consisted primarily of the bright light with peace/serenity, then sudden jolt and return to bodily awareness.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: The bright light appeared "fractionated into 'squares' or 'rectangles'" with colors between golden and yellows, filling the entire visual field without hurting the eyes; followed by "mass confusion" upon return and prolonged amnesia afterward.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "Suddenly there appeared an unearthly bright light upon which I fixated." "It appeared to be fractionated into 'squares' or 'rectangles'... and the colors varied between golden and yellows." "There was total peace and serenity." "Suddenly after seemingly an eternity, there was a sudden jolt and I felt and saw mass confusion around me as reality reappeared."
